title: Safety in Ovarian Cancer for Average-Risk Women - Analysis
official: SOARA: Safety in Ovarian Cancer for Average-Risk Women - Analysis Clinical Validation Protocol
summary: This study is designed to evaluate the safety, specificity, and downstream diagnostic burden of the Evident™ Ovarian Cancer Screening Test in average-risk postmenopausal women. Participants will provide a blood sample for screening and will be followed for approximately 12 months to assess test safety, specificity, downstream diagnostic procedures, and ovarian cancer outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Postmenopausal women with one or both ovaries
* Age 50 years or more
* No personal history of ovarian cancer
* No hereditary cancer syndrome of genetic risk factors associated with ovarian cancer
* Willingness to allow medical record review
* Willingness to have blood drawn
* Ability to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Removal of both ovaries for any reason
* Known genetic risk factors associated with ovarian cancer or hereditary cancer syndrome
* Pregnant or breastfeeding
* Currently under clinical surveillance due to a known or suspected elevated risk of developing ovarian cancer
* Women who are symptomatic and being evaluated for ovarian cancer
* Current untreated malignancy (other than non-melanoma skin cancer)
* Currently receiving adjuvant chemotherapy or radiation therapy for cancer. Patients who are being treated may enroll 3 months after completion of last treatment.
* Anticoagulant use (self-reported)
* Known conditions posing unacceptable phlebotomy risk (self-reported)
* Unwilling to provide the name of primary care physician or provider
* Unwilling to sign informed consent and/or medical records release form.
